cues.en: Stuck at an intersection, you always watch unfold the fundamental problem of traffic. On green, the first car accelerates and then the next and then the next and then the next and then you, only to catch the red. Had the cars accelerated simultaneously,
cues.zh: 在路口堵着时，你总能观察到交通的根本问题 unfold。绿灯亮起，第一辆车加速，然后下一辆，再下一辆，再下一辆，然后轮到你，结果只赶上红灯。如果所有车同时加速，

cues.en: you would have made it through. Coordination,

not cars, is the problem because we are monkey drivers with slow reaction times and short attention spans. Even if we tried, getting everyone to press the pedal on three, two, one now would be challenging. This discoordination limits how many cars can get through an intersection. And when one backs up to the next, that's when city sized gridlock cascades happen, taking forever to clear. In general, more intersections equals more discoordination,
cues.zh: 而不是汽车，才是问题所在，因为我们是反应慢、注意力短的猴子司机。即使尝试让大家在三、二、一、现在同时踩油门，也很有挑战性。这种不协调限制了能通过路口的汽车数量。当一辆车堵到下一个路口时，就会引发城市规模的交通瘫痪，久久无法疏通。一般来说，更多路口等于更多不协调，

cues.en: which equals more traffic. This is the motive behind big highways. No intersections. Splits and merges? Yes. Intersections? No. No stopping. No coordination problems. No traffic. Well, that's the theory anyway. Intersections outside of a highway will back up onto it, again, because human reaction times limit how many cars can escape the off ramp when the light changes. But even without intersections, there would still be traffic on the highway. Traffic can just appear. Take a one lane highway with happy cars flowing until a chicken crosses the road. The driver who sees it breaks a little. The driver behind him doesn't notice immediately and breaks a little harder than necessary. The driver behind him does the same until someone comes to a complete stop. And, oh, look, cars approaching at highway speeds must now stop as well. Though the chicken is long gone, it left a phantom intersection on the highway. This is what's happened when you're stuck in traffic for hours thinking there must be a deadly pile up ahead, and then suddenly the traffic's over with no wreckage in sight. To your relief if you're a good person and mild annoyance if you aren't, you just pass through a phantom intersection, the cause of which is long gone. And this phantom intersection
cues.zh: 也就等于更多交通堵塞。这就是大高速公路背后的动机。没有路口。分叉和汇合？有。路口？没有。不停车。没有协调问题。没有交通。好吧，理论上如此。高速公路外的路口会堵到高速上，again，因为人类反应时间限制了灯变时能有多少车驶出匝道。但即使没有路口，高速上仍会有交通。交通可以凭空出现。拿一条单车道高速来说，车辆顺畅流动，直到一只鸡过马路。看到它的司机稍稍刹车。后面的司机没立即注意，刹车稍重了些。再后面的司机也一样，直到有人完全停下。然后，哦看，以高速驶来的车辆现在也必须停下。虽然鸡早已不见，但它在高速上留下了幻影路口。这就是当你堵车几个小时，想着前面肯定有致命连环撞车，然后突然交通结束却不见残骸时发生的事。如果你是个好人，会松口气；如果不是，会稍感恼火，你只是经过了一个幻影路口，其原因早已消失。而这个幻影路口

cues.en: moves. It's really a traffic snake slithering down the road, eating oncoming cars at one end and pooping them out at the other. On a ring road, a single car slowing down will start an arabrous of traffic that will last forever even though there's no problem with the road. If the drivers could coordinate to accelerate and separate simultaneously,
cues.zh: 会移动。它其实是一条交通蛇在道路上蜿蜒，前端吞入来车，后端排出。在环形路上，一辆车减速就会引发永无止境的交通混乱，即使道路本身没问题。如果司机们能协调同时加速并拉开距离，

cues.en: But they can't, so traffic eternal. On highways, traffic snakes grow if cars are eat it faster than excreted, and they shrink if excreted faster than eat it, dying when the last car accelerates away before the next car must stop. Now in multi lane highways, there needs be no chicken to start gridlock. A driver crossing lanes quickly with cars too close behind is enough to birth a traffic snake that lives for hours and leaves. It's this quick crossing that causes drivers behind to over brake and begin a chain reaction. But we can make traffic snakes less likely by changing the way we drive. Your goal as a driver is to stay the same distance from the car ahead as from the car behind at all times.
cues.zh: 但不可能，所以拥堵永存。在高速公路上，如果车辆汇入的速度快于驶离的速度，拥堵长龙就会增长；如果驶离快于汇入，它就会缩短，当最后一辆车加速离开、而下一辆车还没停下时，长龙就消失了。在多车道高速公路上，不需要有“头车”来引发全面堵死。一个司机快速变道，而后车跟得太近，就足以催生一条能存活数小时才消散的拥堵长龙。正是这种快速变道让后面的司机过度刹车，引发连锁反应。但我们可以通过改变驾驶方式来降低拥堵长龙出现的概率。作为司机，你的目标是始终与前车的距离和与后车的距离保持相等。

cues.en: Tailgating is trouble, not just because it makes accidents more likely, but because you as the tailgater can start a traffic snake if the driver ahead breaks. Always in the middle. This gives you the most time to prevent over braking, also but gives the driver behind you the most time as well. And when stuck in traffic, this rule would get all cars to pull apart the snake faster.
cues.zh: 跟车太近很麻烦，不仅因为它更容易导致事故，还因为如果前车刹车，你作为后车就可能引发一条拥堵长龙。始终保持在中间。这让你有最多时间避免过度刹车，同时也给后车留出最多时间。而当陷入拥堵时，这条规则能让所有车辆更快地把长龙拆散。

cues.en: That's the simple solution to traffic, getting humans to change their behavior, perhaps by sharing this video to show how and why traffic happens, why tailgaters are trouble, and how we can work together to make the roads better for all. The end.
cues.zh: 这就是解决交通问题的简单办法：让人们改变行为，也许可以通过分享这个视频，来展示交通拥堵如何以及为何发生、为什么跟车太近很麻烦，以及我们如何携手让道路对所有人都更好。结束。

cues.en: Except, yeah, wishing upon a star that people are better than they are is a terrible solution every time. Instead, what works is a structurally systematized
cues.zh: 不过，指望靠许愿让人们变得更好，这种做法每次都行不通。真正有效的，是一套结构化的系统化

cues.en: solution, which is exactly what self driving cars are. Self driving cars can just be programmed to stay in the middle and accelerate simultaneously.
cues.zh: 解决方案，而自动驾驶汽车正是如此。自动驾驶汽车可以被编程为保持在车道中间，并同时加速。

cues.en: They'll just do it. The more self driving cars at an intersection, the more efficient the intersection gets. A solid lane of self driving cars vastly increases throughput.
cues.zh: 它们会照做。路口上的自动驾驶汽车越多，路口的通行效率就越高。一整条车道都是自动驾驶汽车，会大幅提升吞吐量。

cues.en: if you ban humans from the road, which we should totally do anyway, you can get rid of the intersection entirely.
cues.zh: 如果把人类彻底禁止上路——反正我们本来就该这么做——你甚至可以把路口整个取消掉。

cues.en: After all, a traffic light is just a tool for drivers on one road to communicate with drivers on another, poorly and coarsely. Red equals don't go now. We are coming through the intersection. Green equals good to go. But self driving cars can talk to each other at the speed of light. With that kind of coordination,
cues.zh: 毕竟，红绿灯不过是一条路上的司机与另一条路上的司机沟通的工具，而且沟通得又差又粗糙。红灯等于“现在别走，我们要通过路口”。绿灯等于“可以走了”。但自动驾驶汽车能以光速互相通信。有了这种协同，

cues.en: no traffic light necessary. Just as with a highway, the best intersection is no intersection.
cues.zh: 就完全不需要红绿灯了。就像高速公路一样，最好的路口就是没有路口。

cues.en: Humans will never drive this precisely. At the intersection, the fundamental problem with traffic that you watch unfold, as with everything, is people. So the real simple solution to traffic is no more monkeys driving cars.
cues.zh: 人类永远开不了这么精准。在路口，你所看到的交通根本问题，和其他一切问题一样，是人。所以交通真正简单的解决方案，就是不再让猴子开车。
